What we recommended on the call:
- Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering (private control plane) or full Private (on-prem) if required for compliance. Dedicated gives predictable throughput and easier onboarding; Private is available for regulated workloads.
- Initial pilot: 2 reserved GPU nodes + burst capacity for peak hours.
